roleFindings.problem: Pool contains items that are not sensible 60-220 g ready-to-eat fruit portions in bowls/snacks.
Role conflates yogurt, milk and buttermilk; some profiles support milk, others require yogurt-like texture.
Flaxseed oil is selected for heated cooking.
Puffed millet and self-rising cornmeal are treated as generic dry grains for one-pot cooking.
Jalapeno/serrano can become 60-220 g main vegetable portions; tomato paste can become 100-220 g main vegetable.
Raw quinoa inherits an 8 minute porridge cook time.
Sweetened coconut and honey-roasted almonds can enter savory legume-nut bowls.
